title: Pea Meteor - 3x Mini Plug Plants - Super Early Pea Variety - Hardy
description:
Pea Seed Variety: ‘Meteor’ (First Early)



Pea ‘Meteor’ is a hardy, first-early garden pea with a compact, dwarf growth habit, making it suitable for exposed sites and smaller growing spaces. It produces a heavy crop of small, well-filled pods from round-seeded plants. It can be sown in autumn (October–November) in suitable areas for overwintering, or spring sowing is also possible.



Plant size (approx.)




- Height: 45 cm (18 in)



- Spread: 25 cm (10 in)



Sowing guidance




- Direct sow outdoors: March to June once soil has warmed



- Mild areas: hardy early cultivars can be sown late autumn to overwinter



- Position: full sun



- Soil: moist, fertile, well-drained, weed-free site



- Sow depth: 4 cm (1.5 in)



- Spacing in row: 5 cm (2 in) apart



- Row spacing: 75 cm (30 in) between rows



- For continuous cropping: sow every 10 days
